rationale.approved: 2026-11-02 direct user approval: eŭfori=快ᴱ and sofism=伪辩. The user regards a dedicated 欣 for the relatively low-frequency eŭfori as weak value because its meaning overlaps the existing 快; preserve the sense of well-being/euphoria in the annotations. The shared 快 already appears in 3 roots, unchanged by shortening; 欣 is removed, body strokes 15 to 7. sofism reuses 伪 (11 to 12 roots) and 辩 (12 unchanged), removes the dedicated 诡, and reduces body strokes 24 to 22. Existing identifier generator yields e for eu^fori and empty id for sofism. No other root identifiers or ownership changes. hibisk=芙 is only a comparison suggestion and remains 芙蓉. Preserve all original meanings, root segmentation, annotations, and historical approvals. Fixed legacy plus current only; no intermediate edition or obsolete aliases.

migration_notice: Only current eŭfori and sofism change. Other owners and fixed legacy assignments stay unchanged. No old-spelling aliases or intermediate editions.
